title: Add Image Sharing and Emoji Support to Chat

requirements.text: Extend the backend message data model to support an optional image payload alongside text. Add a backend function to send a message with an image (stored as a blob or base64-encoded data URL). Update message retrieval to return image data so the frontend can render it.
acceptanceCriteria: The message type includes an optional image field (e.g., ?Blob or ?Text for base64 data URL).
A sendImageMessage (or updated sendMessage) backend function accepts image data and stores it alongside the sender ID, conversation ID, and timestamp.
getMessages returns image data for messages that contain images.
Text-only messages continue to work without any image field required.

requirements.text: Add an image attachment button in the MessageInput component. Clicking it opens a native file picker filtered to image types (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP). The selected image is previewed as a thumbnail above the input bar before sending. On send, the image is uploaded to the backend and displayed as a chat bubble containing the image.
acceptanceCriteria: A paperclip or image icon button appears in the message input bar.
Clicking it triggers a file input that accepts image/* files only.
A thumbnail preview of the selected image is shown above the input bar before sending.
The user can cancel the image selection and return to normal text input.
Pressing send submits the image (as base64 data URL) to the backend.
Sent image messages appear as image bubbles in the chat view, aligned to the right with the sender's style.
Received image messages appear as image bubbles aligned to the left.
Images are constrained to a max width/height and are tap/click-expandable to full size.

requirements.text: Add an emoji picker button to the MessageInput component. Clicking it opens a compact emoji picker panel above the input bar. Selecting an emoji inserts it at the current cursor position in the text input. The picker should include common emoji categories and a search field.
acceptanceCriteria: A smiley face icon button appears in the message input bar.
Clicking it toggles a compact emoji picker panel positioned above the input bar.
The picker displays emojis organized by common categories (smileys, gestures, objects, etc.).
The picker includes a search/filter input for finding emojis by name.
Selecting an emoji inserts it at the current cursor position in the text input field.
The picker closes after an emoji is selected or when the user clicks outside it.
Sent messages containing emoji render correctly in chat bubbles for both sender and receiver.
The emoji picker styling is consistent with the app's dark sidebar / teal-accent visual theme.

constraints: Do not break existing text-only messaging functionality.
Images must be stored in the backend canister (as base64 or Blob); do not use external storage services.
Do not edit any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
nonGoals: Real-time push notifications for new messages.
